summary: Standup. The team covered the sprint board, a flaky test, and a slip in the Atlas CRM rebuild data migration.

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: Morning. Quick round, anything blocking?

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: The nightly build was flaky again, I re-ran it twice.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: On the Atlas CRM rebuild, the data migration is slipping about a week because the contact export has duplicate rows.

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: Do we know how many duplicates?

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Roughly twelve percent of contacts. I will write a dedupe script and share it Thursday.

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: Fine by me. I will pair on the script if you want.

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: Great. Anything else? Lunch order is due at noon.

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: Nothing from me.

summary: Product sync. The team agreed the Mac app needs a signed build before the beta and discussed pricing copy.

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: Let us start with the beta checklist.

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: The Mac app still ships unsigned, so testers hit the Gatekeeper warning on first open.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: I can get the signing certificate sorted this week.

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: Good, then the Mac app beta can go out Friday to the first twenty people.

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: Now pricing copy. The annual plan line reads awkwardly.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: I will rewrite it and send two options.

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: Perfect, thanks everyone.

summary: Design review. Looked at mockups for the login site clients use and agreed on a simpler navigation.

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: Let us walk through the mockups.

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: For the site that clients log into, I cut the menu from nine items down to four.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Does that hide invoices? Clients use the invoices page the most.

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: No, invoices stay on the front page. The self-service pages just get a cleaner layout.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Then I am happy. Colors next?

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: Colors are fixed by the brand guide, nothing to decide.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Okay, then we are done.

name: near-miss-rebuild

summary: Infra check-in. Rebuilt the staging cluster after a failed upgrade and rotated credentials.

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: Staging is back. I had to rebuild the cluster from scratch after the upgrade failed.

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: How long did the rebuild take?

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: About three hours, mostly waiting on images.

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: Did we lose any data?

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: No, it only holds synthetic test data.

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: Good. Credentials were rotated this morning too.

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: Yes, new keys are in the vault.

name: near-miss-hiring-news

summary: Coffee chat. Discussed a competitor's announcement and weekend plans.

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: Did you see the competitor posted their hiring page and a new logo?

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: Yes, the logo looks a lot like ours.

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: Funny. Anyway, how was the weekend?

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: Hiked the ridge trail, very muddy.

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: I stayed in and fixed the bike.

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: Nice. Back to work then.

summary: Office logistics. Security deposit for the new office, badge printers, and parking.

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: The landlord wants a security deposit of two months for the new office.

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: Is that negotiable?

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: They moved to one month after I asked.

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: Great. Badge printers arrive Tuesday, and the front desk security guard needs a list of staff.

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: I will send it. Parking passes are next.

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: Twelve spots, first come first served.

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: Fine.

name: linked-reverses-database

topics.name: Atlas CRM rebuild
topics.description: Replacing the old customer database with a new web app

topics.name: Q3 hiring
topics.description: Hiring two backend engineers

summary: Atlas sync. The team decided to retire the old customer database in January instead of keeping it until March.

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: Status on Atlas first.

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: The new system has run in parallel for a month with no data drift.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: Given that, I do not see why we keep the old customer database until March. It costs us every month.

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: Agreed. Let us retire the old database in January, after the year-end report is exported.

segments.speaker: Eli
segments.text: I will schedule the final export for the second week of December.

segments.speaker: Priya
segments.text: I will tell finance.

segments.speaker: Dana
segments.text: Good. That is all.

prior_decisions: Keep the old customer database running until March

segments.text: Retro time. What went badly?

segments.text: Two testers said the Mac app crashes whenever the laptop wakes from sleep.
